# WF2 — JARVIS Brain Router v5.5

### Changes from v5.4:
- ✅ Fix: ไม่ใช้ n8n credential เลย (ไม่มี httpHeaderAuth/openRouterApi mismatch)
- ✅ Authorization header build จาก $env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY + persona.tokens
- ✅ IF 'Has Auth?' guard: ถ้าไม่มี key → Keyword Fallback (ไม่ call OpenRouter)
- ✅ Merge node รวม 2 paths กลับ → Parse & Route

### ENV required:
- N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false
- OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-...

### Flow:
WF2 Entry → Extract Payload → Prepare JARVIS
→ Has Auth? → [TRUE] Call OpenRouter → Merge → Parse & Route
            → [FALSE] Keyword Fallback ─────↗
→ Dispatch Gate → Format Response
